name: Theremin recital
description: Four public-domain melodies on the theremin: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star; Ode to Joy; Amazing Grace; When the Saints Go Marching In. About two minutes; loops.
axes: x = performer's right, y = up from the floor, z = behind the performer (the performer faces -z, towards Phone A)

songs.name: When the Saints Go Marching In
